command:
set -eu
dav_user=$(awk 'NR==1 {print $3}' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
dav_password=[REDACTED] 'NR==2 {print $3}' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
[ "$dav_user" = editor ]
[ -n "$dav_password" ]
printf '%s\n' "$dav_password" | htpasswd -cBi /etc/httpd/webdav.htpasswd "$dav_user" >/dev/null
chown root:apache /etc/httpd/webdav.htpasswd
chmod 640 /etc/httpd/webdav.htpasswd
sed -i 's/^Listen 80$/Listen 8080/' /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/webdav-documents.conf <<'ANTRIEB_WEBDAV_CONF'
DavLockDB /var/lib/httpd/DavLock

Alias /documents/ "/srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents/"

<Directory "/srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents">
    DAV On
    Options Indexes
    AllowOverride None
    AuthType Basic

umask 077
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/webdav-postreboot.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
dav_user=$(awk 'NR==1 {print $3}' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
dav_password=[REDACTED] 'NR==2 {print $3}' /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/access.txt)
printf 'default login %s password %s\n' "$dav_user" "$dav_password" > "$tmpdir/netrc"
base="http://$NODE_IP:8080/documents"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS_RELEASE='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s\n' "$PRETTY_NAME"
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
printf 'HTTPD_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled httpd
printf 'HTTPD_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active httpd
printf 'LISTENER='; ss -tln | awk '$4 ~ /:8080$/ {print $4; found=1} END {exit !found}'
printf 'FIREWALL_8080='; firewall-cmd --query-port=8080/tcp
anon=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PROPFIND -H 'Depth: 1' "$base/")
printf 'ANONYMOUS_PROPFIND=%s\n' "$anon"
[ "$anon" = 401 ]
auth=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -o "$tmpdir/list.xml" -w '%{http_code}' -X PROPFIND -H 'Depth: 1' "$base/")
printf 'AUTHENTICATED_PROPFIND=%s\n' "$auth"
[ "$auth" = 207 ]
printf 'RESOURCES='
grep -o '<[^:>]*:href>[^<]*' "$tmpdir/list.xml" | sed 's/.*>//' | tr '\n' ' '
printf '\n'
curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" "$base/brief.txt" -o "$tmpdir/brief.txt"
cmp -s "$tmpdir/brief.txt" /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents/brief.txt
printf 'AUTHENTICATED_INITIAL_READ_MATCH=yes\n'
printf 'DOCUMENT_SHA256\n'
sha256sum /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents/brief.txt /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents/budget.csv
printf 'post-reboot-seed\n' > "$tmpdir/seed.txt"
code=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -T "$tmpdir/seed.txt" "$base/post-reboot-lock-test.txt")
printf 'POST_REBOOT_CREATE=%s\n' "$code"
[ "$code" = 201 ] || [ "$code" = 204 ]
cat > "$tmpdir/lock.xml" <<'LOCK_BODY'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:exclusive/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype><D:owner><D:href>editor</D:href></D:owner></D:lockinfo>
LOCK_BODY
code=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -D "$tmpdir/headers" -o "$tmpdir/response" -w '%{http_code}' -X LOCK -H 'Depth: 0' -H 'Timeout: Second-600' -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' --data-binary @"$tmpdir/lock.xml" "$base/post-reboot-lock-test.txt")
printf 'POST_REBOOT_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK=%s\n' "$code"
[ "$code" = 200 ] || [ "$code" = 201 ]
token=[REDACTED] 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /^Lock-Token:[REDACTED] {gsub("\r", "", $2); print $2}' "$tmpdir/headers")
[ -n "$token" ]
printf 'post-reboot-blocked\n' > "$tmpdir/blocked.txt"
code=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -T "$tmpdir/blocked.txt" "$base/post-reboot-lock-test.txt")
printf 'POST_REBOOT_PUT_WITHOUT_TOKEN=[REDACTED] "$code"
[ "$code" = 423 ]
printf 'post-reboot-authorized\n' > "$tmpdir/authorized.txt"
code=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "If: ($token)" -T "$tmpdir/authorized.txt" "$base/post-reboot-lock-test.txt")
printf 'POST_REBOOT_PUT_WITH_TOKEN=[REDACTED] "$code"
[ "$code" = 204 ]
code=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X UNLOCK -H "Lock-Token: [REDACTED] "$base/post-reboot-lock-test.txt")
printf 'POST_REBOOT_UNLOCK=%s\n' "$code"
[ "$code" = 204 ]
code=$(curl -sS --netrc-file "$tmpdir/netrc" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE "$base/post-reboot-lock-test.txt")
printf 'POST_REBOOT_DELETE=%s\n' "$code"
[ "$code" = 204 ]
printf 'TEST_ARTIFACT_PRESENT='; if [ -e /srv/legacy2/webdav-document-locks/documents/post-reboot-lock-test.txt ]; then printf 'yes\n'; exit 1; else printf 'no\n'; fi
